purpose: Synthetic auditor-judgment specifications derived from verified official scope; no executable runtime and no official-exam reconstruction.

specs.title: Define an audit boundary and evidence request
officialDomains: 정보화 관련 법/제도 및 국내외 지침·가이드
감리 관련 법제도 및 관련 기술
specs.purpose: Practice translating a synthetic project mandate into scope, criteria, roles, and evidence requests.
specs.learnerVisibleContext: A fictional public-service system is entering a major release. The project has multiple owners, a vendor, and several overlapping guidance documents.
learnerTask: state the audit objective and boundaries
map criteria to responsible roles
request the minimum evidence needed to test applicability and independence
record one uncertainty that needs confirmation
reviewerDimensions: scope is bounded by facts and authority
criteria are not confused with evidence
responsibility and independence are explicit
uncertainty is recorded rather than guessed

specs.title: Trace a project change into requirements and quality evidence
specs.purpose: Practice reviewing a change request that affects scope, quality, estimate, and acceptance evidence.
specs.learnerVisibleContext: A fictional data-service project receives a late reporting requirement while schedule and staffing are constrained.
learnerTask: trace the change from request to design and acceptance criteria
identify missing impact analysis
compare estimate assumptions with the new scope
propose verification questions
reviewerDimensions: change impacts are connected across scope, quality, and cost
assumptions are visible
acceptance is testable
conclusion distinguishes fact from inference

specs.title: Review delivery, test, method, and operation continuity
specs.purpose: Practice examining whether a release remains controlled from implementation through operation.
specs.learnerVisibleContext: A fictional service uses an iterative delivery method, open-source dependencies, automated builds, and an emergency production fix.
learnerTask: compare the approved source and deployed configuration
review failed tests and emergency-change evidence
identify open-source and dependency responsibilities
state a retest and rollback request
reviewerDimensions: implementation and operation are connected
emergency change is not exempt from evidence
dependency governance is considered
retest and rollback are explicit

specs.title: Review data integrity, application flow, and recovery
specs.purpose: Practice following a synthetic data item through model, query, application, recovery, and analytical use.
specs.learnerVisibleContext: A fictional welfare-data platform has a migration, an API, a search index, backups, and an analytical dataset with derived labels.
learnerTask: trace meaning and ownership from source to derived data
review a bulk change and migration control path
evaluate backup and recovery evidence
identify a data-lineage or dataset-fitness gap
reviewerDimensions: meaning and integrity are distinguished from storage
bulk operations have verification and retry logic
recovery is tested against objectives
analytical data has lineage and fitness evidence

specs.title: Assess architecture, network boundaries, and emerging technology
specs.purpose: Practice assessing architecture assumptions, failure paths, network segmentation, and shared responsibility in a synthetic cloud-connected service.
specs.learnerVisibleContext: A fictional service adds cloud storage, redundant servers, segmented networks, IoT gateways, and an analytics component.
learnerTask: identify single points of failure and capacity assumptions
trace allowed communication paths
review segmentation exceptions
separate supplier responsibility from customer responsibility
reviewerDimensions: quality attributes are linked to design evidence
network paths and exceptions are explicit
failure and recovery assumptions are testable
emerging-technology responsibility is not assumed away

specs.title: Evaluate layered security and privacy controls
specs.purpose: Practice forming a defensible security and privacy review conclusion across identity, network, application, lifecycle, and legal-version boundaries.
specs.learnerVisibleContext: A fictional citizen portal includes privileged accounts, APIs, a mobile client, outsourced development, vulnerability findings, and personal data deletion requests.
learnerTask: trace one identity and one data flow across control boundaries
review a vulnerability exception and retest plan
identify application authorization evidence
state the legal/version facts that must be confirmed before a conclusion
reviewerDimensions: authentication, authorization, and audit evidence are separated
layered controls and response are connected
privacy duties are not simplified into a single consent claim
legal/version uncertainty is preserved

coverageRule: The six specs collectively cover all 23 official domains; practical count is pedagogical and not an official exam structure.
